H7501.def: from «07495» and «0410»; God has cured; Rephael, an Israelite:--Rephael.

H7502.def: a primitive root; to spread (a bed); by implication, to refresh:--comfort, make (a bed), spread.

H7503.def: a primitive root; to slacken (in many applications, literal or figurative):--abate, cease, consume, draw (toward evening), fail, (be) faint, be (wax) feeble, forsake, idle, leave, let alone (go, down), (be) slack, stay, be still, be slothful, (be) weak(-en). See «07495».

H7504.def: from «07503»; slack (in body or mind):--weak. raphah, Raphah. See «07497», «07498». riphah. See «07383».

H7505.def: passive participle of «07495»; cured; Raphu, an Israelite:--Raphu.

H7506.et: from an unused root apparently meaning to sustain
H7506.def: from an unused root apparently meaning to sustain; support; Rephach, an Israelite:--Rephah.

H7508.def: plural of the masculine of the same as «07507»; ballusters; Rephidim, a place in the Desert:--Rephidim.

H7509.def: from «07495» and «03050»; Jah has cured; Rephajah, the name of five Israelites:--Rephaiah.

H7511.def: a primitive root; to trample, i.e. prostrate:--humble self, submit self.

H7513.def: from «07511»; a raft (as flat on the water):--flote.

H7515.def: a primitive root; to trample, i.e. roil water:--foul, trouble.

H7517.def: probably from «07503»; a stall for cattle (from their resting there):--stall.

H7519.def: a primitive root; to run; also to delight in:--accept, run.

H7520.def: a primitive root; probably to look askant, i.e. (figuratively) be jealous:--leap.

H7521.def: a primitive root; to be pleased with; specifically, to satisfy a debt:--(be) accept(-able), accomplish, set affection, approve, consent with, delight (self), enjoy, (be, have a) favour(-able), like, observe, pardon, (be, have, take) please(-ure), reconcile self.

H7522.def: or ratson {raw-tsone'}; from «07521»; delight (especially as shown):--(be) acceptable(-ance, -ed), delight, desire, favour, (good) pleasure, (own, self, voluntary) will, as...(what) would.

H7523.def: a primitive root; properly, to dash in pieces, i.e. kill (a human being), especially to murder:--put to death, kill, (man-)slay(-er), murder(-er).

H7524.def: from «07523»; a crushing; specifically, a murder-cry:--slaughter, sword.

H7526.def: probably for «07522»; Retsin, the name of a Syrian and of an Israelite:--Rezin.

H7528.def: a denominative from «07529»; to tessellate, i.e. embroider (as if with bright stones):--pave.

H7530.def: the same as «07529»; Retseph, a place in Assyrian:--Rezeph.

H7531.def: feminine of «07529»; a hot stone; also a tessellated pavement:--live coal, pavement.

H7532.def: the same as «07531»; Ritspah, an Israelitess:--Rizpah.

H7533.def: a primitive root; to crack in pieces, literally or figuratively:--break, bruise, crush, discourage, oppress, struggle together.

H7534.def: from «07556» in its original sense; emaciated (as if flattened out):--lean((-fleshed)), thin.

H7535.et: the same as (07534) as a noun
H7535.def: the same as «07534» as a noun; properly, leanness, i.e. (figuratively) limitation; only adverbial, merely, or conjunctional, although:--but, even, except, howbeit howsoever, at the least, nevertheless, nothing but, notwithstanding, only, save, so (that), surely, yet (so), in any wise.

H7537.def: a primitive root; to decay (as by worm-eating):--rot.

H7540.def: a primitive root; properly, to stamp, i.e. to spring about (wildly or for joy):--dance, jump, leap, skip.

H7541.def: feminine of «07534»; properly, thinness, i.e. the side of the head:--temple.

H7542.def: from «07534»; thinness; Rakkon, a place in Palestine:--Rakkon.

H7543.def: a primitive root; to perfume:--apothecary, compound, make (ointment), prepare, spice.

H7544.def: from «07543»; properly, perfumery, i.e. (by implication) spicery (for flavor):--spiced.

H7549.def: from «07554»; properly, an expanse, i.e. the firmament or (apparently) visible arch of the sky:--firmament.

H7550.def: from, «07556» in its original sense; a thin cake; -- cake, wafer.

H7551.def: a primitive root; to variegate color, i.e. embroider; by implication, to fabricate:--embroiderer, needlework, curiously work.

H7552.def: from «07551»; versi-color; Rekem, the name of a place in Palestine, also of a Midianite and an Israelite:--Rekem.

H7553.def: from «07551»; variegation of color; specifically, embroidery:--broidered (work), divers colours, (raiment of) needlework (on both sides).

H7554.def: a primitive root; to pound the earth (as a sign of passion); by analogy to expand (by hammering); by implication, to overlay (with thin sheets of metal):--beat, make broad, spread abroad (forth, over, out, into plates), stamp, stretch.

H7555.def: from «07554»; beaten out, i.e. a (metallic) plate:--broad.

H7557.et: from (07556) in its original sense of diffusing
H7557.def: from «07556» in its original sense of diffusing; a beach (as expanded shingle); Rakkath, a place in Palestine:--Rakkath.

H7558.et: from an unused root meaning to have leave
H7558.def: from an unused root meaning to have leave; a permit:--grant.

H7561.def: a primitive root; to be (causatively, do or declare) wrong; by implication, to disturb, violate:--condemn, make trouble, vex, be (commit, deal, depart, do) wicked(-ly, -ness).

H7563.def: from «07561»; morally wrong; concretely, an (actively) bad person:--+ condemned, guilty, ungodly, wicked (man), that did wrong.

H7565.def: from «08313»; a live coal; by analogy lightning; figuratively, an arrow, (as flashing through the air); specifically, fever:--arrow, (burning) coal, burning heat, + spark, hot thunderbolt.

H7566.def: the same as «07565»; Resheph, an Israelite:--Resheph.

H7568.def: from «03423»; a net (as catching animals):--net(- work).

H7573.def: a primitive root; to yoke up (to the pole of a vehicle):--bind.

H7574.def: or rothem {ro'-them}; from «07573»; the Spanish broom (from its pole-like stems):--juniper (tree).

H7575.def: feminine of «07574»; Rithmah, a place in the Desert:--Rithmah.

H7577.def: feminine passive participle of «07576»; something fastened, i.e. a chain:--chain.

H7579.def: a primitive root; to bale up water:--(woman to) draw(-er, water).

H7580.def: a primitive root; to rumble or moan:--X mightily, roar.

H7582.def: a primitive root; to rush; by implication, to desolate:--be desolate, (make a) rush(-ing), (lay) waste.

H7583.et: a primitive root [identical with (07582) through the idea of whirling to giddiness]
H7583.def: a primitive root (identical with «07582» through the idea of whirling to giddiness); to stun, i.e. (intransitively) be astonished:--wonder.

H7585.def: or shol {sheh-ole'}; from «07592»; Hades or the world of the dead (as if a subterranean retreat), including its accessories and inmates:--grave, hell, pit.

H7586.def: passive participle of «07592»; asked; Shaul, the name of an Edomite and two Israelites:--Saul, Shaul.

H7587.def: patronymic from «07856»; a Shaulite or descendant of Shaul:--Shaulites.

H7588.def: from «07582»; uproar (as of rushing); by implication, destruction:--X horrible, noise, pomp, rushing, tumult (X -uous).

H7589.et: from an unused root meaning to push aside
H7589.def: from an unused root meaning to push aside; contempt:--despite(-ful).

H7590.def: for active part of «07750» (compare «07589»); one contemning:--that (which) despise(-d).

H7592.def: or shael {shaw-ale'}; a primitive root; to inquire; by implication, to request; by extension, to demand:--ask (counsel, on), beg, borrow, lay to charge, consult, demand, desire, × earnestly, enquire, + greet, obtain leave, lend, pray, request, require, + salute, × straitly, × surely, wish.

H7595.def: (Aramaic) from «07593»; properly, a question (at law), i.e. judicial decision or mandate:--demand.

H7596.def: or shelah (1 Samuel 1:17) {shay-law'}; from «07592»; a petition; by implication, a loan:--loan, petition, request.

H7597.def: or Shaltiy(el {shal-tee-ale'}; from «07592» and «0410»; I have asked God; Shealtiel, an Israelite:--Shalthiel, Shealtiel.

H7599.def: a primitive root; to loll, i.e. be peaceful:--be at ease, be quiet, rest. See also «01052».
